signals.title: Missing moeb tool: Read (start_spec result file)
signals.description: Used Read (Claude Code built-in) to read the large start_spec result file written to an absolute host path. The moeb read_file tool cannot access this path.
signals.proposed_resolution: Extend start_spec to return large content via a moeb-accessible relative path, or add a moeb tool for reading kernel-generated output files by run_id.

signals.title: Missing moeb tool: Glob (file discovery)
signals.description: Used Glob (Claude Code built-in) to discover .github/workflows/*.yml files. moeb list_directory and search_files were available.
signals.proposed_resolution: Use mcp__moeb__list_directory and mcp__moeb__search_files for file pattern discovery in spec sessions.

signals.title: Missing moeb tool: Read (pre-authoring file inspection)
signals.description: Used Read (Claude Code built-in) to inspect .github/workflows/release.yml before authoring. moeb read_file was available.
signals.proposed_resolution: Use mcp__moeb__read_file for all file reads within the spec invocation.

signals.title: patch_file fails on long README table rows
signals.description: Four consecutive patch_file calls failed on .moeb/README.md with 'All context lines appear in the file'. Very long table row lines (500+ characters) appear to cause hunk relocation or diffy apply to malfunction. A write_file fallback was required.
signals.proposed_resolution: Investigate diffy line-length limits or relocate_hunk_positions behaviour with very long context lines. Add regression tests.
